Notes on building small, durable software

November 4, 2026 · 8 min read

SECRET-SENTENCE-7731 Most software dies of neglect rather than complexity. The tools that last tend to be boring on purpose, with fewer moving parts and clear seams.

Make it work, make it right, make it fast.
function durable(x) {
  return x ?? fallback();
}
Heads up: this essay assumes you have shipped something before.
